source_semantics.source_definition_identity_policy: The source definition is mode-neutral. PREPARED versus LIVE belongs to acquisition and admission mode so P1C2 can reuse this exact mapping.
source_semantics.price_meaning: A price explicitly listed for the identified product in one captured public page snapshot. It does not establish transaction price, availability, taxes, shipping, motive, or market impact.
source_semantics.price_validation_boundary: AttributeMappingV1 has no numeric min/max declaration. The public decimal_text_to_number interpreter instead requires bounded decimal text, faithful finite JSON-number representation, and compatibility with the ontology number target; no private numeric rule is added.
source_semantics.currency_meaning: The explicit three-letter currency code captured beside the listed price; it is comparison context, not a value to convert implicitly.
source_semantics.publication_time_policy: A source publication or event-effective time may be null when the page does not disclose one.
source_semantics.as_of_policy: When publication or event-effective time is unavailable, the attributable price Observation preserves observed_at as the source-time fact and uses ingested_at as the replay-safe resource as-of cutoff.
source_semantics.availability_policy: No derived resource may be available before the source snapshot's ingested_at time.

fixture_schema_migration.captured_payload_encoding: captured_payload is canonicalized through ace.core.canonical_json before contract construction

legacy_fields.source_snapshot_ref: Removed from fixture input; Core derives the exact content-addressed reference from the complete canonical snapshot envelope.
legacy_fields.source_digest: When this meant the captured payload digest it is now named captured_payload_digest; Core separately derives source_snapshot_digest from the complete envelope.
legacy_fields.acquisition_receipt: Removed from fixture input; only its prepared provenance reference and digest are carried, without asserting acquisition success.

prohibited_adapter_outputs: claims about motive or market impact
live or durable admission without host-resolved authority and acquisition receipts
limitations: The Market-owned source mapping is compiler-supported and interpreted only through Platform P1C1's public PREPARED interpreter.
The named snapshot fixture is structural capability-binding identity material only; this package ships no executable source adapter.
The acquisition receipt reference and digest are PREPARED provenance only and do not assert live capture or acquisition success.
The prepared authority binding proves exact activation shape and grants no live source access.
P1C2 remains responsible for live adapter binding, use-time capability and authority resolution, acquisition receipt resolution, capture, and LIVE admission.
